author: Jared Darwish
title: Raiders searching for keys to consistency - NewsBreak
text:
By Jared Darwish ,
1 hours ago
HUNTINGBURG, Ind. (WEHT) – Last year’s raiders team had lots of talent at the top but lacked some needed depth where it mattered.
But that could be changing this year with a more experienced Southridge squad.
“We have got some guys who are at least familiar with playing on Friday nights and what that is like and so right know we are just trying to figure out, who our guys are and how to put those puzzle pieces together,” said Head Coach Scott Buening.
For a program that accomplished their 20th winning season in a row consistency wouldn’t usually be on the list of things to improve upon; but after going just 6-5 in 2025 this raiders group is eager to get back on track.
“I think this group has had a little bit of urgency this summer on the field and in the weight room as we get started with some of those things,” said Buening.
Despite losing more than 2,000 yards of offense in senior QB Justin Leathers and having other key departures in the rushing game, Buening says the depth and experience gained from last year will help these raiders improve.
One piece of the puzzle already solved for these raiders is placing Parker Steckler at the helm. The senior QB comes into the season as a three-year starter with experience at every skill position on offense last year.
“Being at every position definitely helps with giving pointers and stuff and anything that helps the team get better,” said Steckler.
Steckler was a big part of this group that finished last season 5-1 and by the looks of it, seem to be carrying that momentum into this season, which means that tradition of consistency and winning could be coming back to Huntingburg very soon.
“Been a really good group, they work really well together, and they do things right so hopefully they reap some of those rewards this year,” said Buning.
